claims: Thacker Pass has substantial strategic financing/liquidity and late-2027 mechanical-completion targeting, but remains pre-production and exposed to capex, commissioning, lithium-price and dilution risk.

At the Sep. 21, 2026 close, reported market capitalization of about $1.08B provides valuation headroom if Thacker Pass executes, but project-stage uncertainty prevents exceptional valuation treatment.
